correctness.rationale: The finite-state Markov matrices and geometric tail are exact. The identity A0^h=H+(z/2)^h E is verified algebraically; B E B vanishes at degree zero with upper-left coefficient -z/8. Thus only h=r-1 affects coefficients through degree r, by precisely -2^(-2r) per gap; multiple corrections have strictly greater degree. Negative-binomial expansion and Kummer give the assertion. Exact rational checker tests 264 configurations including all boundary profiles in finite grids; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an infinite-rank exact layer-by-layer carry distribution in the natural sparse-digit regime and identifies the sharp finite separation threshold and first nonzero interaction defect. This directly resolves the motivated structural question of when low-carry statistics decouple, beyond isolated numerical calculations or direct renaming of a known fixed-parameter formula.
